messages:
jess: Heads-up: seeing tiny token-shift after KV-resume on parallax-32k-int8 canary. Repro steps below.
omar: what're the repro steps? :eyes:
jess: Short repro: start convo, prefill ~20k tokens, stop, resume from cached KV; tokens ~20345-20350 change (spacing/punct) vs baseline. Not huge but fails our goldset exact-match checks.
jess: Minimal curl to reproduce locally against qa: ```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \n  -H \"X-Redwood-Model: parallax-32k-int8\" \n  -d '{"input":"<seed prompt>... (20k tokens)"}' \n  https://qa.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
priya: any pattern by quant level? int8 only? int4? fp16?
jess: Quick sanity: int8 reproduces reliably, int4 quick check looked cleaner (but not exhaustive). fp16 seems fine. Also only reproducible when using warmstart/hand-off of KV between shards (we do shard swap).
liam: can you paste the runtime log lines around the mismatch?
jess: snippet: ```
[2024-10-31 14:12:02.334] INFO kv-resume shard=2 seq_start=20300 seq_end=20480
[2024-10-31 14:12:02.336] WARN token-check pos=20345 expected=\" the\" got=\" the\n\"
[2024-10-31 14:12:02.337] DEBUG kvcache: checksum(shard2,20300-20480)=0x7a3f9b
```
ciaran: could be RoPE wrap/scale interaction + quant rounding at boundary. Did you try toggling rotary scaling or index remap?
jess: set ROTARY_SCALE=1.0 and ROTARY_SCALE=0.999 both tested. Frequency reduced but didn't vanish. Also tried disabling the per-token prefix-caching layer with env DISABLE_PREFIX_CACHE=1 and it fails much less often.
omar: sounds like a cache-eviction / boundary alignment problem with chunk size. Can you bisect on prefill chunk size? 1k vs 2k vs 4k?
jess: Ran quick bisect: 1k chunk reproduces most reliably; 2k sometimes; 4k rarely. Attached short harness script in repo: ```python
# run_repro.py (minimal)
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
cli.generate(model='parallax-32k-int8', input=open('seed.txt').read(), use_kv_warmstart=True)
```
priya: next steps: create jira KV-TRIAGE ticket, label flaky-long-prefill, assign to @liam for systematic runs across int4/int8/fp16 on dedicated-qa and prod-sim. I'll run quant bench for rounding sensitivity.
liam: taking it. I'll run exhaustive runs with: shard-swap on/off, prefix-cache on/off, chunk sizes 512/1024/2048, and 3 seeds. ETA EOD.
ciaran: if liam wants deeper tracing I can enable kernel-level tracing in runtime (kv index maps + RoPE idx) and dump raw KV vectors for positions around 20340-20355. Also try `--disable-prefix-caching` and `--force-rotary-remap` flags.
jess: :thumbsup: added small goldset and seed files to https://github.com/redwood-inference/kv-repro/tree/jess/parallax-32k and updated README with exact run command.
kv-bot: deploybot: triggered canary build 2024-11-02-2310 for parallax-32k-int8 on dedicated-qa.
omar: once liam confirms RoPE-index drift, we need a hotfix path before wide roll. Prefer a runtime patch that adds a strict index-check in handoff.
jess: I'll update the jira with logs + exact seed + link to bench. Ping me if you need infra creds.
liam: will post run artifacts + initial diff here when done.
ciaran: assigned to kernel-trace queue if we need deeper dump.
priya: thanks all, keeping this high priority for onboarding parallax-32k.
